9 times in 3 weeks.

That's how many times Republicans in DC have blocked funding for TSA.

The chaos at the airports needs to stop and TSA agents need to be paid now.

Enough with the games. Fund TSA.
The SAVE America Act is designed to save one thing and one thing only: Donald Trump's power.

We all agree TSA workers should be getting paid. So what's the hold up? Fund TSA now.

Video

Instead of sending a paramilitary force into our airports, the President should simply tell Republicans in the Senate to fund TSA.


Sefenech Henok (@SefenechHenokTV)

Ice Agents arrive at @ATLairport 

@11AliveNews











— https://nitter.net/SefenechHenokTV/status/2036042116808212667#m

Fund TSA now.


Everything Georgia (@GAFollowers)

Atlanta airport had a line out of the DOOR this morning!

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/GAFollowers/status/2036052466890908074#m

This is what desperation looks like. 

President Trump wants Republicans to BLOCK funding for TSA until Congress passes his voter suppression bill. 

He is terrified that the American people have turned against his failed agenda.

We now know why Republicans in DC have been blocking TSA funding. 

It’s because President Trump wants to use TSA as leverage to pass his voter suppression bill. 

Enough with the games. Fund TSA now.

TSA workers have not been fully paid in 30+ days. 
 
Yet Republicans here in Washington have literally decided to suspend the business of the Senate to solely focus on ramming through their voter suppression bill.

Gas prices going up. 
Another war in the Middle East. 
A nationwide health care crisis. 
 
And this President is laser-focused on forcing you to get a passport to be able to vote.

Donald Trump would rather change the electorate than change his disastrous policies.

Video

An update on the SAVE Act.

Video

They're not even trying to hide what the SAVE Act is really all about. 
 
It's about making sure only the "right people" vote. 
It's to "guarantee the midterms." 
 
They're trying to silence your voice and protect their own power.
Some in Washington would rather make it harder for you to vote than actually pursue an agenda that makes your life better.

Here is the simple truth: 
 
The SAVE Act is a voter suppression bill.
.@SenJackyRosen's bill will make sure TSA agents get paid. Let’s get it done.

I just tried to fast track a bill to pay TSA workers NOW. 

Sadly, Republicans in DC keep blocking it. 

We all agree that TSA should be paid so what is the hold up? This is insanity.


Ella Dorsey (@Ella__Dorsey)

Y'all... I've NEVER seen Hartsfield Jackson this bad. This is what security looks like this morning (Friday). We've talked to people that got to the airport at 3am that missed their 6am flight. 
@ATLNewsFirst @GAFollowers

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/Ella__Dorsey/status/2034953

This is getting lost in the conversation.

We already have laws on the books that penalize non citizens for voting with harsh penalties. 

It is exceedingly rare for this to happen, but when it does, violators are held accountable.

So if this is already on the books, what is the SAVE America Act really about?

It's all a pretext to stop AMERICANS from voting.

Specifically, Americans who dare to disagree with the President and Republicans in Washington DC.

As the holy month of Ramadan comes to a close, I want to wish the Muslim community in Georgia and across the nation a joyous and peaceful Eid al-Fitr! 
 
May peace be upon you!

If those who wanted to limit voting to only the “right people” in the 1960s had succeeded, I would not be in the Senate today.

Video

No money for your health care.
No money for hungry families.
No money for grandma’s nursing home.
No money for Elmo.
No money for cancer research.

But endless money for war.
